User story / work item: As project owner I need a clear charter so the initiative has objectives and boundaries
Acceptance criteria: Need objectives scope assumptions constraints and success criteria

User story / work item: As reviewer I need a scope baseline so included and excluded work is explicit
Acceptance criteria: Three workstreams and exclusions are defined

User story / work item: As project owner I need a WBS and schedule to sequence delivery
Acceptance criteria: Work packages dependencies milestones and estimates are traceable

User story / work item: As reviewer I need stakeholder and RACI artifacts to understand accountability
Acceptance criteria: Stakeholder archetypes and one accountable role per activity are documented

User story / work item: As project owner I need risk responses to protect data integrity and credibility
Acceptance criteria: High exposure risks have mitigation or avoidance responses

User story / work item: As data owner I need invalid user rows rejected consistently
Acceptance criteria: Validation and rejection rules are tested and documented

User story / work item: As database reviewer I need persisted users verified
Acceptance criteria: MySQL 8.0 CI validates stored row counts and constraints

User story / work item: As database reviewer I need assignment relationships protected
Acceptance criteria: Foreign keys and duplicate pair checks are verified in MySQL CI

User story / work item: As auditor I need timestamps normalized and events traceable
Acceptance criteria: Timestamp parsing and actor/event constraints are tested

User story / work item: As project owner I need a status report that separates evidence from assumptions
Acceptance criteria: Technical evidence and PM metrics gaps are disclosed

User story / work item: As reviewer I need outcomes and lessons learned consolidated
Acceptance criteria: Closure report lists deliverables gaps and next steps

User story / work item: As a project coordinator I need a Jira board and Confluence space to operationalize tracking
Acceptance criteria: Board and pages created with traceable issue links
